snippet.title: Foamstars - Launch Trailer | PS5 & PS4 Games
snippet.description:
https://playstation.com/games/foamstars

Let the bubbles fly in FOAMSTARS - the brand new 4v4 foam-party shooter, available to download and play at no extra cost now with PlayStation® Plus as part of the February Monthly Games line-up.
Blast through fast-paced battles using foam to attack your opponents, carve paths to slide through the arenas at speed and build structures to defend your team.
Join the foam-blasting frenzy!

#ps5 #ps5games #ps4games #ps4 #foamstars
